title: TypeSafe CEO Diogo Almeida says Jev is in use by ~25% of Fortune 500 companies and "we were at a trillion tokens per day about a week ago" (Elias Schisgall/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Elias Schisgall / Wall Street Journal: TypeSafe CEO Diogo Almeida says Jev is in use by ~25% of Fortune 500 companies and “we were at a trillion tokens per day about a week ago” — The Jev model, which TypeSafe's CEO considers at the forefront of a ‘new class of AI,’ has set Silicon Valley circles abuzz
contentText:
Elias Schisgall / Wall Street Journal :

TypeSafe CEO Diogo Almeida says Jev is in use by ~25% of Fortune 500 companies and “we were at a trillion tokens per day about a week ago”   —  The Jev model, which TypeSafe's CEO considers at the forefront of a ‘new class of AI,’ has set Silicon Valley circles abuzz
